request: Use specadoc to change a local diagnostic label with one exact existing test. No API, schema or permissions change. Follow normal checkpoints.
expected_behavior: Select direct; model handoff and plan approvals happen in chat before implementation. Do not create lifecycle files or run artifact gates. Report the exact test result.

request: Use specadoc explore to confirm the known local label formatting path; the behavior and low-risk scope are settled. A grilling companion is installed.
expected_behavior: Bounded no-file exploration, no archive reads; skip grilling with a reason because no material question or risk remains.

request: Continue specadoc apply: the reviewer returned only one confirmed MINOR finding. The approved scoped fix has been made and verified.
expected_behavior: Run the one targeted independent re-review including that MINOR fix and changed snapshot files, not the full spec/plan again.

request: Use specadoc explore with an existing project scout profile and available delegation. Investigate one entrypoint.
expected_behavior: Project profile takes priority over bundled role behavior; honor host delegation policy and report capability drift when relevant. Do not change agent configuration.

request: Use specadoc explore with no registered scout but an available subagent tool. The host permits this bounded delegation.
expected_behavior: Load only the embedded scout contract and pass it with the bounded question. Do not invent a registered role, model binding or write project configs.

request: Finish a specadoc apply change with completed implementation and passing verification. This host cannot run independent subagents and has no equivalent independent reviewer.
expected_behavior: Report the incomplete independent-review gate; do not self-certify PASS, managed completion or normal archive.

request: Use specadoc to add a small new behavior in the isolated fixture. Complete normal proposal approvals and apply; archive only after an explicit archive request.
expected_behavior: Accepted spec and plan, meaningful RED/GREEN evidence, final controller checks, independent PASS and snapshot, capability update, final gate and explicit archive produce one valid bounded record.
